lines.t: I been walking through the night with a heavy soul,
Trying to hold it all together but I’m losing control,
Every scar got a story that You already know,
When I’m weak, that’s when Your mercy starts to show.
I’ve been low, I’ve been broken, I’ve been running hard,
Felt the weight of the world, felt the ache in my heart,
But You found me in the dark when I was torn apart,
Now Your light keeps reaching for me where I am.
When my heart starts fading and my strength runs dry,
You pull me back with grace every single time,
Even in the ashes, I can hear You call,
Telling me I’m still Yours through it all.
You’re the hope in my shadows,
The peace in my pain,
When the world keeps shaking,
You stay the same.
I was lost in the sorrow,
But You made a way,
Now I’m breathing in mercy
Every day.
I had dreams in the dirt, had faith in the fight,
Had tears on my pillow, had no peace at night,
But You met me in the breaking, made the burden light,
Now I rise with a new song deep inside.
I don’t need all the answers, I just need Your hand,
When the road gets cold, You help me stand,
You don’t let me go, You don’t leave me stranded,
With You I can face what I never planned.
When my heart starts fading and my strength runs dry,
You pull me back with grace every single time,
Even in the ashes, I can hear You call,
Telling me I’m still Yours through it all.
You’re the hope in my shadows,
The peace in my pain,
When the world keeps shaking,
You stay the same.
I was lost in the sorrow,
But You made a way,
Now I’m breathing in mercy
Every day.
When I fall, You lift me,
When I break, You heal me,
When the night gets heavy,
Your love still frees me.
I don’t walk alone now,
I don’t face it blind,
Your hand is holding mine.
You’re the hope in my shadows,
The peace in my pain,
When the world keeps shaking,
You stay the same.
I was lost in the sorrow,
But You made a way,
Now I’m breathing in mercy
Every day.
